title: Explosion-Proof Intelligent Inspection Robot Solution
summary: Sevnce Robotics reports pilots of its explosion-proof inspection robot at a substation and a chemical plant and states its efficiency and cost gains only as expectations.
source_collection: ITU AI for Good: Innovate for Impact (2025)
account: Sevnce Robotics, a Chinese company, reports pilot projects of its explosion-proof inspection robot at a large substation and at a chemical plant. The submission names neither site and gives no date or result for either pilot. It states its efficiency, cost and failure figures as expectations, so the improvements in inspection remain projected.
purpose: Inspect hazardous industrial equipment while reducing manual exposure.
